options.label: Inject feedback into analysis
options.description: When (re)analyzing a thread, include its saved feedback (and recent feedback on similar cases) in the claude -p prompt alongside the guidelines. Immediate, targeted effect — a Re-analyze instantly respects your note. Small change.

options.label: Build the guidelines writer
options.description: The deferred #22 piece: a step that reads the whole feedback corpus and proposes edits to session-manager-cases.md (you review/accept), so lessons become durable policy for all threads. Bigger.

options.label: Both
options.description: Inject feedback now for immediate effect, AND build the writer so feedback graduates into guidelines over time. Recommended end state.

options.label: Leave it manual
options.description: Keep today's behavior: feedback is just a note for you; you hand-edit guidelines via the Edit-guidelines button when you want a lesson to stick.
